{{Quote|That's music to my ears. Hello, Valon. I've been waiting for this since we buried Antilles.|Felix Iresso|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Antilles''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Felix Iresso]]'s command who served in the [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Antilles and fellow soldier [[Dask]] were both [[Death/Legends|killed]] while fighting the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]].
